title: Payment Rails in West Africa: What Actually Works
lesson: Mobile money volumes exceed card volumes in every Francophone West African market. Build for that first.
description: After 6 months of payment integrations across Nigeria, Ghana, and Senegal: mobile money is not a fallback, it's the primary rail. Cards are used by fewer than 15% of payers in most B2B contexts outside Lagos.

title: Trust Signals That Actually Convert in B2B West Africa
lesson: A CAC registration number and a physical address converts better than any social proof badge.
description: Ran informal A/B tests across landing page variants for Korporty. Compliance signals (CAC number, registered business address, regulatory mentions) consistently outperformed testimonials and logos.

title: Why SMEs in West Africa Abandon Software in Week Two
lesson: Onboarding that requires more than one document upload loses 60% of users before activation.
description: Data from 40 SME interviews. Abandonment spikes at: document verification, bank account linking, and any step that requires a person to call a bank. The fix isn't simplification — it's progressive disclosure. Get them to first value before asking for compliance.
